title: Select and Strike
description: The Bulk Actions panel's Approve/Cancel buttons are only meaningful once something is checked — and the heading counting "N selected" is the one piece of UI a dispatcher trusts to know what they're about to strike from the manifest. Put both under pressure.
successCondition: On the Admin console's Bulk Actions panel, both "Approve selected" and "Cancel selected" are disabled while zero shipments are checked; checking one checkbox enables both buttons and updates the heading to read "Shipments · 1 selected"; unchecking it again disables both buttons and the heading returns to "Shipments · 0 selected" — verified across at least three check/uncheck cycles, not just one.
hints: The heading and button disabled state both derive from the same Set of selected ids — a stale closure bug would show up as a mismatch between the two.
Use the checkbox's own change event rather than clicking the row — the label wraps the input so either works, but the checkbox is the more precise locator.
